question: I have keys but open no doors. What am I?

You use me to dry off after a bath. What am I?

You wear me on your feet before your shoes. What am I?
You open me to go inside your house. What am I?
I help you see yourself every morning. What am I?
You sleep on me every night. What am I?
I hold your clothes but do not wear any. What am I?
You brush your teeth with me. What am I?
I keep rain off your head. What am I?
You write with me, but I am not a pen. What am I?
I am full of pages but not a tree. What am I?
You walk on me inside your home. What am I?
I hold water in the kitchen and bathroom. What am I?

I keep your pants from falling down. What am I?
You wear me on your wrist and I tell the time. What am I?

You use me to erase pencil marks. What am I?
